Proud to collaborate with Edmonton’s dental community

At Mayra Dental Clinic, we value strong professional relationships and thoughtful interdisciplinary care. We’re honored to support local dentists by providing specialist-led treatment planning and in-house dental laboratory services for precise, reliable restorations.

 

Clinicians refer to us for:

  • Single-tooth dental implants
  • Full-arch implant rehabilitation (All-on-X / Teeth in a Day)
  • Implant-supported dentures
  • Full mouth reconstruction
  • Complex restorative cases and second opinions
  • Prosthodontic treatment planning
  • In-house dental laboratory services for precise and reliable restorations

Our goal is simple: to deliver exceptional outcomes while supporting your patient experience and protecting the trust you’ve built.

Dr. Arif Sumar

Led by a specialist in complex restorative care

Mayra Dental Clinic is led by Dr. Arif Sumar, a prosthodontist with advanced training in complex reconstruction, implant dentistry, and high-level treatment planning. Known for meticulous precision and long-term outcomes, Dr. Sumar approaches every case with integrity, clinical excellence, and deep respect for both the patient and the referring provider.
